Subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs) — next steps

Alex / Lisa — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed MAP milestone for the integration build plan so we have explicit owners, deliverables, and a target close date. See the attached MAP draft (MAP_draft_v2.xlsx) and a short integration spec (integration_spec.md).

High level milestone: Integration build plan (SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs)
- Target close date: 2026-08-14 (aiming for GA prep week of 8/17)
- Responsibilities / owners:
  - SDK integration (mobile + web): Marcus Lin (marcus_lin) — implement SDK shim, sample apps, auth flows
  - Streaming & low-latency: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek_kulkarni) — streaming client patterns, reconnect/resume, test harness
  - Tool-calling & structured outputs: Rafael Mendes (rafael_mendes) — tool invocation schema, structured JSON outputs, validation tests
- Dependencies: Acme test env (API keys + staging data), security review (SOC2 evidence + network rules), access to customer feature flags for feature gating
- Success criteria: end-to-end demo with streaming + tool call + validated structured JSON; perf within agreed P50 latency for key flows; docs and sample apps in repo

Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm owners and dates):
1) Acme to provide staging API keys + test dataset by 7/23 — Alex/Lisa
2) Redwood to deliver initial SDK integration PR + sample app by 7/30 — Marcus
3) Redwood to deliver streaming client patterns + perf smoke tests by 8/6 — Vivek
4) Redwood to run tool-calling validation with Acme sample payloads by 8/10 — Rafael

If that timeline works we can lock the MAP milestone and add these line items into the project tracker. Happy to adjust dates if any dependency is a blocker.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Adding a couple of specifics and accepting the owners for the milestone. Rafael here — I'll take lead on tool-calling and structured outputs. Quick notes:

- Tool-calling schema: I'll draft a minimal example (invokeTool name/args / requestId / timeout) and attach to the MAP. Expecting to iterate with Acme payloads.
- Structured outputs: we'll include canonical JSON schemas and a small validation layer in the SDK that returns typed errors for schema mismatches.
- For streaming: Vivek, we'll want to align on support for WebSocket + optional SSE fallback. If we target WebSocket primarily we can still provide an SSE shim for simpler clients.
- Dependencies I want to call out: our infra team needs a staging subnet open to Acme IP ranges; security will need the SOC2 evidence pack (I'll loop in security if we need to accelerate).

I'll post the example payload and a one-pager on the tool-calling flow by EOD 7/21.

Rafael
